meta.title: Suggestions (for review, not implemented)
meta.intro: Suggested improvements to this site and to the research. Nothing below has been implemented. Choose which paths to pursue. Each has a status of Pending until you decide.

items.title: Record dated price snapshots from each hotel's official booking calendar
items.benefit: Only way to answer 'cheapest time to book' and the 7-night totals with real, verified prices.
items.effort: Medium (manual or scripted; repeat over several weeks)
items.risk: Prices change daily; snapshots must carry a date and time.

items.title: Use the official RTC trip planner to record travel minutes for each hotel-to-activity pair
items.benefit: Turns the 1-hour travel requirement into a verified check.
items.risk: Schedules change; RTC reports a funding shortfall and Strip construction changes.

items.title: Confirm the subway requirement with you
items.benefit: The brief says subway or bus. Las Vegas has no subway on official sites read so far.

items.title: Decide between a 3-night (Feb 15 to 18) plan and a 7-night plan (Feb 15 to 22) as the base
items.benefit: Sets every total, every price table and every booking window.

items.title: Add a per-row 'last checked' date and a link checker that runs before each publish
items.benefit: Shows the age of each verified value. Catches dead links.

items.title: Add a Michelin filter by tier and area (Strip, Chinatown, Downtown, Off-Strip)
items.benefit: Makes clusters easy to compare on a phone.

items.title: Add a map view of hotels, restaurants and activities
items.benefit: Shows travel distance at a glance; helps the 1-hour check.
items.effort: Medium (needs a map provider and verified coordinates from official sources)
items.risk: Coordinates must come from official addresses, not inferred.

items.title: Add a scoring sheet with weights you choose (price, Michelin count, bed, bathroom, travel time)
items.benefit: Makes the hotel ranking transparent and adjustable.
items.risk: Weights are subjective; need your input (Q2, Q7).

items.title: Verify room bed types and bathroom wording on each hotel's official room page
items.benefit: Confirms the hard requirement for each hotel.
items.risk: Room pages may not load in some tools; use a manual check if needed.

items.title: Add a 'source freshness' rule: any value older than 30 days is marked stale
items.benefit: Stops stale prices and hours from looking current.

items.title: Publish the Michelin list from guide.michelin.com as a second check once it loads
items.benefit: Two official sources agree before publication.
items.risk: guide.michelin.com did not load through the fetch tool this session.

items.title: Consolidate the three parallel branches on GitHub into one site build before merging to main
items.benefit: Avoids duplicate pages and conflicting data.
items.risk: Other branches claim the same scope; merging without reconciling can break the site.
